method.confirmation: For each model and precision with a regression or incomplete cell against the historical baseline, measured baseline, candidate, candidate, baseline on the same physical GPU. Each recorded sample is a median of 11 repetitions. Each side's estimate is the median of its two samples.
method.gate: Each of the two time and two peak-allocated-memory measurements per system passes at <=3% regression. Unavailable cells retain their execution status.
method.cpu: Same pre-refactor checkpoint in candidate and pre-extraction revision 46c9fc4. Compared energy, force, coordinate derivative and all trainable parameters for the energy-plus-force squared loss. DPA4 additionally used a fixed nonzero output projection to exercise nonzero attention gradients.

cuda_scatter.method: The original bitwise CUDA reference failed on duplicate-destination floating-point atomics. Compare production and torch_scatter against a float64 reference with the per-destination floating-point addition error bound.

mattersim_geometry_pooled.method: Median of the four samples per side pooled across both same-card baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline rounds. Each sample is an eleven-step median.
